PLATINUM SERIES
The Seasonic Platinum Series achieves extremely high power conversion efficiency and unbelievably tight 2 % voltage regulation. Every model features a patented DC Connector Module Back Panel with Integrated VRM and LLC/Full-bridge circuit topology. The Platinum series defines what genuine premium power supplies should be by delivering the complete package; ultra-high efficiency, excellent dynamic response, and customizable cable arrangement that can be tailored to meet any individual needs.
The higher the level of efficiency of the power supply, the less power gets wasted in the form of excess heat . The 80 PLUS® Platinum certification guarantees greater than 90 %, 92 % and 89 % efficiency at 20 %, 50 % and 100 % operating loads, respectively.
